metadata.title: Will I eat dog meat | क्या मैं कुत्ते का मीट खा सकता हूं ?
metadata.description: We travel to the remote areas of India to meet tribal people. India has a population of about 10 crore tribal people spread across different states. India is full of cultural and linguistic diversity and so is tribal societies of the country. India has countless food and food preparation and we try to bring you different foods of tribal in India. The idea is to understand the diversity of the tribal society through their food. But we have received some comments asking us not to eat with tribals. Here we explain why we will not accept this advice.
